text: Aljanaaji ñiiɓal e duumal ɗi ɓe naatata, canɗi no ila senngo ley kuɓeeje e leɗɗe majji. Hino woodani ɓe e ɗin Aljannaaji, kala ko wonkiiji maɓɓe tuuyetee e ñaametee e njaram ekw. Ko wano ndii njoɓdi ndi Alla yoɓitiri gmɗuɓe ɓen e mofte Muhammadu (jom-kisiyee) ɗen, O yoɓitirta gomɗuɓe e mofte adinooɓe ɓen.
